title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：stability　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stability 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the clerk ① kept the stability that no applicant in the office would have described, and he said the keeping was the whole of the month. The ② stability, meaning the balance itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; stability, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of stability in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ stability at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Stability, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the stability was the whole of the matter, meaning the security and not the balance. The ⑥ stability, meaning the security and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; stability, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both balance and a security. He said the security is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ stability had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ stability of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of describing; stability, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ stability I remember is the stability described in the file, which closed in 1984 and is still described as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Stability, my mother said in 1986, is the only thing that improves by being described; all stability, she said, is a security that has agreed to look like balance. She said the security was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 稳定（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 稳定（指那份稳定本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the stability 维持这一份稳定
D. n. 稳定（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 稳定之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的稳定之事）
F. n. 稳定（指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一份）
G. n. 稳定、安稳（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 安稳（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the stability that no applicant in the office would have described
The stability, meaning the balance itself and not the stamp
Every sort of stability in that office
the stability at the far counter
the stability was the whole of the matter
the stability had become a line in a file
The stability of the whole thing

answers.why: keep the stability 意为“维持这一份稳定”，1977 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一份稳定做了一遍。
stability 意为“稳定”，指那份稳定本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
stability 意为“稳定”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
stability 意为“稳定”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
stability 意为“稳定、安稳”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份安稳就是那件事的全部。
stability 意为“安稳”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份稳定，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
stability 意为“稳定”，指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一份，到 1982 年这一份成了卷宗里的一行。
stability 意为“稳定之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的稳定之事是一处办事处和三个月份的描述。
stability 意为“稳定”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一份，1984 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一份。
stability 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，稳定是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的稳定。
